governing_rule: R1 is one merged release over partially different national instruments; merged variable continuity never proves national-instrument uniformity.
Shared Q/administrative codes corroborate only; proposition, accepted semantic role, response topology and source context govern continuity.
Different codes may be continuous when mutual high-similarity proposition evidence and accepted semantic-role agreement support a wording-revision ruling.
Bracketed national office/actor substitutions are preserved as implementation context and normalized only for discovery; exact source wording remains authoritative.
Country-only, filter, condition and split implementations remain distinct; they cannot be collapsed into round-general nodes.
Accepted structural mapping blocks, code batteries and shared stems are inventory/search surfaces only and confer no V550J authority.
